units.source_text: 她的丈夫特莱密是个拥有埃及王室血统的贵族，因此她的运动获得诸多的方便。

en.t: Her husband, Ptolemy, was a nobleman with Egyptian royal blood, and therefore her movement gained many advantages.

units.source_text: 但是，要让数千年来闭锁在暗无天日的黑暗中的埃及妇女觉醒、要求男人赞成这种觉醒，绝非容易的事。

en.t: But it was by no means easy to awaken Egyptian women who had been shut away for thousands of years in sunless darkness, or to demand that men approve of that awakening.
